description: This file defines the DashletsDialog class, which manages retrieving and setting up available dashboard widgets (dashlets) categorized by type for a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM interface. It loads dashlet metadata, handles localization, icon selection, ACL permissions, and prepares dashlet data for UI display.

classes.name: DashletsDialog
classes.description: A class responsible for aggregating and preparing dashlet (widget) information for display in the CRM interface.

methods.name: getDashlets
methods.description: Loads and filters dashlet metadata files, handles localization, icon determination, ACL permissions, and categorizes dashlets for UI presentation.
